verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's deployment tracking records deploys and correlates them with errors. It can filter errors that occurred since the last deploy and links to a code diff against the previous deploy, which gives a thin, error-centric view of release health. Nothing in the evidence shows the session- and user-based release health metrics the story asks for. missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, canary-vs-stable release comparison, independent corroboration.
